title: Or the work of folks like @davidekirkland and Maisha Winn who show us how the @nctq vision of the world reinforces inequity and the dominant narrative
summary: Or the work of folks like @davidekirkland and Maisha Winn who show us how the @nctq vision of the world reinforces inequity and the dominant narrative of the world by denying the literacy practices of underrepresented people. Academic discourse IS white discourse
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Or the work of folks like @davidekirkland and Maisha Winn who show us how the @nctq vision of the world reinforces inequity and the dominant narrative of the world by denying the literacy practices of underrepresented people. Academic discourse IS white discourse
